camel_example: aliyun cms PutMonitorGroupDynamicRule --region cn-hangzhou --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Name hostName --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Value nginx --GroupRules.1.Category ecs --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Function contains --IsAsync false --GroupRules.1.FilterRelation and --GroupId 123456
description_en: Creates or modifies an alert rule to dynamically add instances that meet the rule to an application group
description_zh: 调用PutMonitorGroupDynamicRule接口创建或修改按照实例名称动态匹配的应用分组，满足匹配规则的所有实例自动添加到该应用分组中
name: PutMonitorGroupDynamicRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group
parameters.name: group_id

fields.help_en:
The logical operator used between conditional expressions in the alert rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 3. Valid values:

and: The instances that meet all the conditional expressions are automatically added to the application group.

or: The instances that meet one of the conditional expressions are automatically added to the application group
fields.help_zh:
动态报警规则的组合条件。N的取值范围：1~3。取值：

and：满足所有报警规则的实例才会自动添加到应用分组。

or：满足任意报警规则的实例都会自动添加到应用分组
fields.name: filter_relation

fields.help_en: The value to be matched with the specified field. Valid values of N: 1 to 3
fields.help_zh: 满足报警条件的值。N的取值范围：1~3
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The name of the field based on which instances are filtered. Valid values of N: 1 to 3.

Only hostnames are supported. Example: hostName
fields.help_zh:
实例匹配的字段名称。N的取值范围：1~3。

目前仅支持主机名，例如：hostName
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The method that is used to filter instances. Valid values of N: 1 to 3. Valid values:

contains: contains

notContains: does not contain

startWith: starts with a prefix

endWith: ends with a suffix
fields.help_zh:
实例的过滤条件。N的取值范围：1~3。取值：
contains：包含。
notContains：不包含。
startWith：前缀。
endWith：后缀
fields.name: function

fields.help_en:
The cloud service to which the alert rule is applied. Valid values of N: 1 to 3. Valid values:

ecs: Elastic Compute Service (ECS)

rds: ApsaraDB RDS

slb: Server Load Balancer (SLB)
fields.help_zh:
动态报警规则的云服务类型。N的取值范围：1~3。取值：

ecs：云服务器ECS。

rds：关系型数据库。

slb：负载均衡
fields.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The mode for creating the alert rule. Valid values:

true: creates asynchronously

false (default): creates synchronously
parameters.help_zh:
创建动态报警规则的模式。取值：

true：异步创建。
false（默认值）：同步创建
parameters.name: is_async
